Samir — thanks for the clear list. Looping Ben (SE) and Marissa (AM) so you get both pricing and operational perspectives. Below is a compact set of options and the things we typically recommend for mid-market teams running similar workloads.

1) Conversion structures (common paths)
- Seed + metered monthly: one-time seed credit (recommended: 1–2 months of expected spend) that guarantees capacity for the first month, then month-to-month metering. Pros: low commitment from your side, easy to start. Cons: slightly higher per-token rates vs reserved commits.
- Short-term reserved (3–6 month): smaller commit with a discount ladder as you hit thresholds. Good if you expect steady growth and want predictability.

2) Feature bundling model
- Our product supports mix-and-match for most add-ons on hosted plans (Core tokens are independent; Retrieval and KV cache are add-ons). However, Dedicated and Private tiers include different entitlements — some features (e.g., persistent per-customer KV cache with dedicated throughput) require Dedicated. We can map your required entitlements and keep the rest as add-ons so you don't have to jump tiers unnecessarily.

3) Downgrade/proration policy
- Month-to-month metered customers: you can downgrade feature add-ons at month boundary; billing prorates on a daily basis for add-on deactivation.
- Reserved commits: commits are time-bound; early termination carries the remaining committed balance as a credit that can be applied to metered usage or future commits (we can negotiate flexible amortization for larger deals).

4) Discounts & incentives
- Standard early-conversion incentive: one-time 10% credit on first 3 months for seed+metered conversions that convert within 30 days of trial.
- If you choose a 6-month reserved commit we can discuss a stepped discount (15–20% depending on commit size).

Next steps I propose:
- If you can share approximate 3-month consumption forecast (Alicia mentioned ~50M tokens/month), Ben and I will draft a concrete pricing matrix and two sample invoices (seed+metered and 6-mo commit) for your procurement to compare.
- Marissa can prepare a short operations checklist for onboarding and what features require Dedicated vs Hosted.

Ben/Marissa — can you take the action items below? Samir/Alicia — happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Logan

Thanks — jumping in with the technical constraints that affect packaging choices. Short answers first, details below.

Short answers:
- Mix-and-match: yes for hosted (Core tokens + Retrieval + transient KV cache).
- Persistent, high-throughput KV and guaranteed latency: requires Dedicated.
- Switching from Hosted -> Dedicated mid-contract: supported, but there is an operational lead time (typically 2–4 weeks) and a migration plan.

Details/notes:
- Retrieval add-on is billed as a per-query fee + storage fee for retriever indexes. If Zenwell wants to keep indexes persistent but not move to Dedicated, we can host indexes in your VPC (Private option) for an additional ops fee.
- If you plan to do heavy real-time inference (tail-latency <100ms SLO), Dedicated is the recommended path because of kernel-level optimizations and sustained throughput guarantees. For batch/jitter-tolerant pipelines, hosted + caching is fine.
- Downgrading a Dedicated capacity pool is possible, but you need to coordinate with capacity planning so we don't oversubscribe GPUs; proration rules apply but for large multi-month commits we typically structure a credit amortization to soften the hit.

Action: Logan, I'll draft a pricing matrix with two flavors: (A) Hosted mix-and-match with add-on pricing (seed+metered), (B) 6-mo small reserved Dedicated bucket with entitlement mapping. I'll push the draft to the shared Drive link and flag any assumptions.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Proposal (summary)
- Path A (Low-commit): Seed credit = $25k (applies to first month). Then month-to-month metered billing. Add-ons: Retrieval billed at $0.0025/query + $0.015/GB/month for index storage. Discount: 10% credit on first 3 months (applies as invoice credit).
- Path B (Predictable): 6-month reserved commit: $120k total (applied as monthly amortized credit). Includes Retrieval add-on at a 12% reduced rate and one free 1-day dedicated migration run for rehydration of your indexes if you move to Dedicated during the commit. Tier entitlements: Core tokens + Retrieval; dedicated KV cache would require a small dedicated bucket add-on ($6k/mo).

Downgrade & proration
- Add-on downgrades take effect at month boundary and prorate daily for the month in which the change is made.
- If you choose Path B and need to step down after month 3, we will amortize the unused commit into an account credit (usable for metered billing or future commits).

What we need from you
- Signed acknowledgement of preferred path (A or B) and confirmation that the attached pricing matrix matches expectations.
- If Path B, confirm start-of-commit date so we can reserve capacity.

Next steps
